title: LUMOS: A Modular Open-Source LLM-Based Agent Framework
text_preview: We introduce the overall design and two formulations for developing agents within this framework.

title: LUMOS Agent Architecture
text_preview: For various complex interactive tasks, a common solution would include: (1) decomposing the task into a series of subgoals, (2) converting subgoals into concrete actions, (3) executing those actions.
